name: Citizenship by Descent

requirements.blocker_text: A child with at least one Montenegrin-citizen parent acquires Montenegrin citizenship, whether born in Montenegro or abroad, applied without distinction between mother and father.

sources.title: Lawyers Montenegro (private legal-guide site) -- describes descent citizenship for children with at least one Montenegrin parent, applied without gender distinction, whether born in Montenegro or abroad

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Montenegro). STATUS: DRAFT -- sourced to a private legal-guide site (tier 3); Refworld hosts the current 2024-amended primary legal text (Zakon o crnogorskom drzavljanstvu) but this build could only retrieve its catalog metadata, not the PDF's substantive articles -- worth a dedicated follow-up to pull that PDF directly and upgrade this citation to tier 1/2. An older, no-longer-in-force version of the law (pre-2008, itself confirming gender-neutral descent under the earlier SFRY-successor framework) was also reviewed and is consistent with this finding, though it is not the current authority. GENUINE POSITIVE FINDING: descent citizenship is gender-neutral on its face, consistent with Kenya, Pakistan, India, Tunisia, Tanzania, and Kazakhstan's reformed descent rules built elsewhere in this dataset. dual_citizenship_allowed set false per Montenegro's general, consistently-reported non-acceptance of dual citizenship (see me_citizenship_naturalisation.json's notes for the narrow exceptions that exist).
